_notes: Roles (dev-guide Sections 7.11 and 7.26). A role owns the tactics of a bot: there is no team-wide slider over them any more, so what a role says is what a bot does. `rangePref` names all three bands, best first, and `weaponPref` names archetypes, best first. A player builds a team by choosing a role for each of the three bots, which makes the composition one categorical choice that a batch can sweep. Every number is a placeholder. TBD Section 7.48.7: the Overwatch `weaponPref` is ordered by the MEASURED long-band share of each archetype (marksman 72.6 %, precision 51.8 %, splash 16.3 %, assault 8.0 %). `denial` used to sit third at weight 1.36, nearly matching precision, and it fires 0.5 % of its shots long -- it is a close-range weapon. `versatile` sat fourth and `archetypeOf` can never return it, so that slot was dead and it diluted the two archetypes that do the work. `tank` and `skirmisher` still carry the dead `versatile` entry and their own tails are not ordered by measurement.
